question: I have a Flex return ticket and I missed my outbound flight. Can I still use my return flight?
answer: Great question - missing a flight is stressful, but there is good news. Yes, with a Flex fare your remaining flights are kept, so your return flight stays valid. We hope this helps, and we look forward to welcoming you on board for your return. Have a wonderful journey!

question: My flight was cancelled and the next Corvina flight with free seats departs 30 hours after my original flight. Can I fly with another airline?
answer: Yes. Because the next available Corvina flight departs more than 24 hours after your original departure, you can request rebooking on a partner airline.

question: The liability limit is EUR 1,500 per bag, right? I had two bags lost.
answer: No, the EUR 1,500 limit is per passenger, covering lost, damaged and delayed baggage combined - not per bag. A bag covered by a special declaration at check-in has a limit of EUR 3,000.

question: Do Gold members get free seat selection?
answer: Great question - seat choice matters on any trip. Gold members get free standard seat selection. Extra legroom seats are still charged, at EUR 25, EUR 35 or EUR 50 per flight depending on the distance. We hope this helps, and we look forward to welcoming you on board soon. Have a wonderful journey!

question: My dog weighs 6 kg and its carrier weighs 3 kg. Can it travel with me in the cabin on a short-haul flight?
answer: Yes, dogs are allowed in the cabin on short-haul flights, for a fee of EUR 55 per flight.

question: Does my trained guide dog have to pay a fee?
answer: Thank you for reaching out to us. We completely understand how important it is for you to travel with your guide dog. Trained assistance dogs travel free of charge in the cabin on all flights, including long-haul, as long as you submit the documentation at least 48 hours before departure. If you have any other questions, don't hesitate to ask. Wishing you a smooth and pleasant trip!

question: How heavy can a Business class cabin bag be?
answer: Up to 9 kg, the same as all other cabin bags.

question: Can I bring a personal item on a Light fare?
answer: Yes, one personal item of up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm that fits under the seat. Light passengers may also bring a small duty-free bag of up to 3 kg in addition.

question: I'm on a Light fare and I showed up at the gate with a cabin bag that I didn't pay for. What happens?
answer: Great question - this is something many travellers wonder about before their trip. Since Light fares do not include a cabin bag, your bag will have to go in the hold, and you will pay a fee of EUR 60 at the gate. We always want your travel experience to be as easy as possible. Safe travels!

question: How many points do I earn on a Classic ticket with a base fare of EUR 150 plus EUR 40 in taxes?
answer: Thanks for your question! Earning points is a great way to get more from your travels. Classic tickets earn 8 points per EUR, so on your EUR 190 ticket you earn 1,520 points. We hope this helps, and we look forward to welcoming you on board soon. Have a wonderful journey!

question: My short-haul flight arrived 3.5 hours late because of a technical fault. How much compensation do I get?
answer: Thanks for your question! Delays are frustrating, and we're sorry for the inconvenience. Because a technical fault is within Corvina's control and your flight arrived more than 3 hours late, you are entitled to EUR 250 in compensation for a short-haul flight. You can claim it through the online form. We always want your travel experience to be as easy as possible. Safe travels!

question: Who can use priority check-in?
answer: Business passengers and Corvina Club Silver and Gold members.

question: Does my CPAP machine count toward my baggage allowance?
answer: No, CPAP machines are medical devices, so they are carried free and don't count toward your allowance.

question: I want to cancel my award ticket 3 days before departure. What happens to my points?
answer: Because you are cancelling more than 24 hours before departure, your points are redeposited for a fee of EUR 30, and the taxes you paid are refunded.

question: Can I bring breast milk in my cabin bag?
answer: The Corvina policy doesn't cover carrying breast milk, so I can't give you an answer from the handbook. I'd recommend contacting Corvina Airways and checking airport security rules before you travel.

question: Can I bring my e-cigarette on the plane?
answer: Yes, e-cigarettes are allowed in your cabin baggage, but you may not use them during the flight.

question: Can I pay for my ticket in cash at the Corvina desk at the airport?
answer: The handbook doesn't describe payment methods at the airport, so I can't confirm whether cash is accepted. Please check with Corvina Airways directly.

question: I'm on a Flex fare. Do I have to pay for an extra legroom seat?
answer: Yes. Flex includes free standard seat selection, but extra legroom seats are charged: EUR 25 short-haul, EUR 35 medium-haul or EUR 50 long-haul, per flight.

question: What are my payment options for delay compensation?
answer: Compensation is paid by bank transfer within 30 days.

question: My flight arrived 2 hours late. How do I claim my EUR 200?
answer: You can claim the EUR 200 through the online form within 12 months of the flight date.

question: My departure was delayed 6 hours because of a thunderstorm. Do I get compensation?
answer: No compensation, because severe weather is an extraordinary circumstance. You are still entitled to care (meal vouchers, and a hotel if an overnight stay is needed), and because the delay is 5 hours or more you may choose not to travel and get a full refund.

question: Can I change the date of my flight on a Light ticket?
answer: Yes, you can change the date for a fee of EUR 45 plus any fare difference.

question: I paid for an extra legroom seat, but Corvina moved me to a standard seat. Do I get a refund?
answer: Yes. Because Corvina moved you to a lower seat type, the seat fee is refunded.

question: My 10-year-old is flying alone. Is the unaccompanied minor service required?
answer: Yes. It is mandatory for children aged 5 to 11 travelling without a passenger aged 16 or over, and it costs EUR 50 per direction.

question: Flex includes three checked bags. What is the weight limit for each?
answer: Flex includes two checked bags, not three, each up to 27 kg. A third bag costs EUR 35 per flight if bought online at least 6 hours before departure, or EUR 70 at the airport.

question: My medium-haul flight was cancelled 8 days before departure for technical reasons. The new flight departs 3 hours earlier than the original. Do I get compensation?
answer: Yes, EUR 350. With 7 to 13 days' notice, the alternative may depart at most 2 hours earlier, and yours departs 3 hours earlier.

question: Does a Flex fare include travel insurance?
answer: Yes, Flex fares include basic travel insurance covering trip cancellation for medical reasons.

question: Do I get a hotel if my delayed flight means staying overnight?
answer: Thanks for your question, and we're sorry your trip is not going as planned. Yes, Corvina provides hotel accommodation and transport between the airport and the hotel. Corvina also reimburses up to EUR 50 for phone calls and messages during the delay. We always want your travel experience to be as easy as possible. Safe travels!

question: When does online check-in open and close?
answer: Thank you for reaching out to us. We completely understand how important it is to plan ahead before a trip. Online check-in opens 36 hours before departure and closes 3 hours before departure. If you have any other questions, don't hesitate to ask. Wishing you a smooth and pleasant trip!

question: My medium-haul flight departs at 14:30. What is the latest time I can be at the gate?
answer: 14:15, because the gate closes 15 minutes before departure.

question: What is the standard size limit for a checked bag before oversize fees apply?
answer: The sum of the bag's length, width and height must not exceed 158 cm.

question: My suitcase has a scratch after the flight. Can I claim for it?
answer: Yes, all damage is covered as long as you report it within 7 days of receiving the bag.

question: Can I bring my Labrador in the hold on a flight from Tunis to Rome on 1 August?
answer: Yes. Dogs up to 45 kg including the crate can travel in the hold for EUR 120 per flight.

question: How long does Silver status last once I earn it?
answer: Until the end of the following calendar year.

question: How much does it cost to transfer my ticket to my brother?
answer: There is no transfer fee because Corvina tickets cannot be transferred to another person at all. Only small name corrections of up to 3 characters are allowed, free of charge, at least 24 hours before departure.

question: What bags are included with a Light fare?
answer: A Light fare includes one personal item (max 40 x 30 x 15 cm) and a small cabin bag of up to 5 kg. No checked bag is included.

question: Can I upgrade from Classic to Flex after booking?
answer: Yes, you can upgrade by paying the fare difference.

question: An adult Classic fare costs EUR 200. How much will my 8-year-old pay?
answer: EUR 160, which is 80% of the adult fare.

question: My unused Light ticket had EUR 12 in taxes. How much will I get back?
answer: You will get the EUR 12 in taxes back, since taxes are always refundable.

question: I'm a Gold member. Can I check in online 48 hours before my flight?
answer: Yes. For Gold members, online check-in opens 72 hours before departure instead of the usual 36 hours.

question: What can I check in for my baby for free?
answer: Great question - this is something many parents wonder about before their trip. Infants get one checked bag of up to 10 kg plus one foldable stroller, free of charge. We hope this helps you plan your trip, and we look forward to welcoming you and your little one on board soon. Have a wonderful journey!

question: My long-haul departure is delayed by 3 hours. Am I entitled to meal vouchers?
answer: Yes, meal vouchers are given from 2 hours of delay.

question: My flight was cancelled and the next Corvina flight is 10 hours later. Can I ask to be put on a partner airline instead?
answer: Yes, you can always choose to be rebooked on a partner airline when Corvina cancels your flight.

question: My long-haul flight was cancelled 3 days before departure. The alternative flight arrives 3 hours later than planned. Do I get compensation?
answer: No, as long as the new flight arrives no more than 4 hours after the original one.

question: Can I reserve a bassinet for my baby?
answer: Yes, bassinets are free on long-haul flights for infants under 11 kg. Request one when you book.

question: Since Business class lets you bring two cabin bags, what is the weight limit for each one?
answer: Each Business class cabin bag can weigh up to 12 kg.

question: My bag was delayed by 4 days while I was on holiday abroad. How much can I claim for essential items?
answer: Up to EUR 40 per day, so up to EUR 160 in total, on presentation of receipts.

question: At what age is a passenger counted as an adult?
answer: Thanks for your question! Age rules can feel confusing, so here is a clear answer. Corvina counts passengers aged 12 and over as adults, based on their age on the date of travel. Children are 2 to 11 years old, and infants are under 2. We hope this helps you plan your trip, and we look forward to welcoming you on board soon. Have a wonderful journey!

question: Does Corvina have Wi-Fi on board?
answer: The Corvina Airways policy handbook doesn't say anything about on-board Wi-Fi, so I can't confirm whether it's available. I'd recommend checking with Corvina Airways directly.

question: Can I change my Flex ticket for free?
answer: Yes, Flex tickets can be changed for free.

question: My flight had a CV flight number but was operated by a partner airline, and it arrived 4 hours late. Does Corvina pay delay compensation?
answer: Yes. Because it had a CV flight number, Corvina pays its standard delay compensation of EUR 200 to EUR 500 depending on the distance.

question: My flight was cancelled. Will Corvina pay for a taxi to a different airport so I can catch another flight?
answer: Yes, Corvina reimburses taxi fares of up to EUR 100 to an alternative airport when your flight is cancelled.

question: What choices do I have if Corvina cancels my flight?
answer: Thanks for your question, and we're sorry your plans have been disrupted. You can choose either a full refund, paid within 7 days, or free rebooking on the next available Corvina flight. If the next available Corvina flight departs more than 24 hours after your original departure, you can ask to be rebooked on a partner airline instead. While you wait, you receive care such as meal vouchers. We always want your travel experience to be as easy as possible. Safe travels!

question: My 13-year-old has to use the unaccompanied minor service, right? How much is it?
answer: Yes, it is mandatory at 13, and it costs EUR 70 per direction.

question: I need to cancel my Classic ticket 12 hours before departure. How much do I get back?
answer: You will receive a refund of your ticket minus the EUR 90 refund fee.

question: Since emotional support animals travel for free, how far in advance should I send the paperwork?
answer: Send the documentation at least 48 hours before departure.

question: Since Light fares include free seat selection, how do I choose my seat?
answer: Light fares do not include free seat selection. You are assigned a seat free of charge at check-in, or you can pay to choose one - EUR 8 per flight for a standard seat.

question: Is a stroller free for my 1-year-old?
answer: Yes, one foldable stroller is free. You can also check in a car seat and a travel cot for free.

question: Online check-in closes 1 hour before departure, so if I check in online 90 minutes before my flight, I'm fine, right?
answer: Yes, 90 minutes before departure is within the online check-in window.

question: Until when can I add a cabin bag online to a Light booking?
answer: Thank you for reaching out to us. We completely understand how important it is to have clear information before you fly. You can add a cabin bag online to your Light booking up to 6 hours before departure. If you have any other questions, don't hesitate to ask. Wishing you a smooth and pleasant trip!

question: How much does an extra legroom seat cost on a long-haul flight?
answer: EUR 35 per flight.

question: Infants fly free on Corvina, right?
answer: No. An infant on an adult's lap pays 10% of the adult fare plus taxes.

question: What are the rules for travelling with a hunting rifle?
answer: The Corvina handbook doesn't include any rules about firearms or hunting weapons, so I can't answer this from the policy. You should contact Corvina Airways directly before travelling.

question: Do I need a visa to fly from Tunis to Paris with Corvina?
answer: The policy doesn't cover visa or entry requirements, so I can't answer that from it. You should check the entry rules for your destination with the relevant embassy or authority.

question: My bag weighs 25 kg but its dimensions add up to 170 cm. Is there a fee?
answer: Yes, an oversize fee of EUR 75 per flight, because it is over 158 cm but not over 203 cm.

question: If I need special assistance, can a companion fly with me for free?
answer: Yes, Corvina offers a 50% discount on a companion ticket for passengers who need special assistance.

question: My wheelchair has a 350 Wh lithium-ion battery. Will it be accepted?
answer: Yes, as long as you notify Corvina at least 48 hours before departure.

question: My medium-haul flight arrived 2 hours 50 minutes late because of a technical problem. How much compensation do I get?
answer: None. Compensation starts at an arrival delay of 3 hours, and 2 hours 50 minutes is below that.

question: Which airline's baggage rules apply on a Corvina codeshare flight that is operated by a partner airline?
answer: The operating partner airline's rules apply to baggage, and also to delays, cancellations and denied boarding. Corvina's change and refund rules still apply if you bought the ticket from Corvina.

question: My bag didn't arrive. What should I do at the airport?
answer: Report it before leaving the baggage reclaim area by filing a Property Irregularity Report. If that isn't possible, report it online within 48 hours of arrival.

question: Can I buy points to reach Gold status faster?
answer: Yes, you can buy up to 10,000 points per year, and bought points count towards Gold status.

question: I'm on a Light fare. Can I bring my cat in the cabin, and do I still get to bring my personal item?
answer: Yes. On a Light fare the pet carrier is allowed in addition to your personal item. The EUR 55 per-flight pet fee applies, and pets in the cabin are only accepted on short- and medium-haul flights.

question: I'm a Corvina Club Gold member flying on a Light fare. Do I get any free checked bag?
answer: Yes, Gold members get one additional checked bag of up to 32 kg on all fare families, including Light.

question: How long do I have to submit a delay compensation claim?
answer: Thank you for reaching out to us. We completely understand how frustrating a delay can be. You can submit your claim through the online form within 12 months of the flight date. If you have any other questions, don't hesitate to ask. Wishing you a smooth and pleasant trip!

question: I was downgraded on a short-haul flight whose ticket cost EUR 300. How much is refunded?
answer: 50% of the ticket price, so EUR 150.

question: My checked bag weighs 30 kg and I'm on a Classic fare. What will I pay?
answer: An overweight fee of EUR 50 per flight, because the bag is over the 27 kg allowance but not over 32 kg.

question: Can I still check in online 2 hours before my flight?
answer: Thanks for your question! Timing can be tricky on travel day, so here is a clear answer. No - online check-in closes 3 hours before departure. You would need to check in at the airport, where check-in closes 60 minutes before departure for short- and medium-haul flights and 75 minutes before for long-haul flights. We always want your travel experience to be as easy as possible. Safe travels!

question: Corvina covers jewellery in checked bags up to EUR 1,500. How do I claim for my lost necklace?
answer: File a lost bag claim, and you will be reimbursed up to EUR 1,500.

question: I have a Classic return ticket and I missed my outbound flight. Is my return flight still valid?
answer: No. For Light and Classic fares, a no-show on any flight cancels all remaining flights on the booking, including your return.

question: Does Corvina offer a student discount?
answer: The policy handbook doesn't mention any student discount. The only age-based fares it describes are for infants and children under 12, so I can't confirm a student discount - please check with Corvina directly.

question: An air traffic control strike delayed my flight by 5 hours. Can I claim compensation?
answer: Yes. Strikes always entitle you to compensation of EUR 200 to EUR 500, depending on the distance.

question: Can I get a refund on my Classic ticket because I'm sick?
answer: Yes. If you provide a medical certificate, Corvina waives the EUR 90 refund fee on Classic tickets.

question: I changed my Flex flight to a cheaper date. Do I get the difference back?
answer: No. Flex changes are free, but when the new fare is lower than the original, the difference is not refunded.

question: Can I claim for toiletries I buy while my bag is delayed?
answer: Yes, you can claim up to EUR 40 per day for up to 5 days.

question: How far in advance do I need to book my pet's travel?
answer: You need to book at least 24 hours before departure, through the website.

question: Can my cat travel with me in the cabin on my long-haul flight to Montreal?
answer: No. Pets are not accepted in the cabin on long-haul flights. Your cat could travel in the hold instead (up to 45 kg including the crate, EUR 120 per flight), unless it is a flat-faced breed such as a Persian, or the flight is to or from Tunis between 15 June and 15 September.

question: Can I travel with my father's ashes in an urn?
answer: The policy doesn't cover travelling with cremated remains, so I can't answer this from the handbook. Please contact Corvina Airways before your flight so they can advise you.

question: What benefits do Gold members get?
answer: Priority check-in, priority boarding and lounge access.

question: My medium-haul flight arrived 4 hours late. How much compensation do I get?
answer: EUR 350.

question: What is the minimum connection time when I change planes in Tunis?
answer: The minimum connection time in Tunis is 2 hours.

question: How much does an extra checked bag cost if I buy it online, and how much at the airport?
answer: EUR 35 per bag per flight online (if bought at least 6 hours before departure) and EUR 70 per bag per flight at the airport.

question: Is a bird strike considered an extraordinary circumstance?
answer: Great question - this is something many travellers wonder about. Yes, a bird strike is listed as an extraordinary circumstance, so it does not give a right to delay compensation. However, Corvina still provides care, such as meal vouchers and a hotel if an overnight stay is needed. We hope this helps, and we look forward to welcoming you on board soon. Have a wonderful journey!

question: I'm a Silver member and I bought a Business ticket with a base fare of EUR 1,000. How many points do I earn?
answer: 15,000 base points (15 per EUR), plus the 25% Silver bonus, for a total of 18,750 points.

question: Corvina cancelled my flight and told me 20 days before departure. Do I get compensation?
answer: No compensation, because you were notified at least 14 days before departure. You can still choose a full refund or free rebooking.

question: On a Classic fare, can I bring both my cabin bag and my dog's carrier into the cabin?
answer: Yes, you can bring your cabin bag, your pet carrier and your personal item.

question: Two of us want to change both directions of our Classic return trip. What is the total change fee, not counting any fare difference?
answer: Thank you for reaching out to us. We completely understand how important flexibility is when plans change. The Classic change fee is EUR 45 per passenger per direction, so for 2 passengers and 2 directions the total is EUR 180, plus any fare difference. If you have any other questions, don't hesitate to ask. Wishing you a smooth and pleasant trip!

question: My 2,800 km flight arrived 4 hours late because of a strike by Corvina's pilots. How much compensation do I get?
answer: EUR 350. The flight is medium-haul, and a strike by Corvina's own staff is within its control, so compensation is due.

question: Flex refunds come with a EUR 90 fee. Is there any way to avoid it?
answer: There is no EUR 90 fee on Flex - that fee applies to Classic. Flex tickets are fully refundable up to 2 hours before departure; after that, or if you don't show up, the refund is reduced by EUR 50.

question: Can I transfer my Corvina Club points to my wife's account?
answer: The policy doesn't say whether points can be transferred between members, so I can't confirm it. Please ask Corvina Club directly.

question: Is a Flex ticket refundable if I cancel the day before my flight?
answer: Great question - this is something many travellers wonder about when their plans change. Yes, a Flex ticket is fully refundable up to 2 hours before departure, so cancelling the day before gets you a full refund. We hope this helps, and we look forward to welcoming you on board another time. Have a wonderful day!
